objective: reuse the live parent-writeback commit bus to satisfy an immediately released spatial parent dependency without a parent-SRAM read

forwarding_contract.hit_definition: the exact selected parent task has commit_time equal to the current admission cycle and is present on the parent-writeback commit bus
forwarding_contract.late_event_rule: a commit event with commit_time less than the current admission cycle is not a hit
forwarding_contract.data_action_on_hit: route the live committed vector to the delta input and do not issue a parent-SRAM read
forwarding_contract.data_action_on_miss: issue the unchanged M91 parent-SRAM read
forwarding_contract.broadcast_rule: multiple children may consume one exact-tag commit value in the same cycle
forwarding_contract.arithmetic_identity: W*x = W*p + W*(x-p) with disjoint signed add/subtract masks

accounting_contract.source_cycles: must be recomputed by the coupled scheduler and may not regress versus M91
accounting_contract.integrated_cycles: includes the unchanged command, response/context, parent-SRAM, final-accumulator, output and DMA calendars

kill_conditions: any arithmetic, dependency, accounting, occupancy or per-sample gate failure
aggregate integrated improvement below 0.25 percent versus M91
requiring a retained vector cache, a previous-timestep bypass, or any payload duplication
requiring a dependency edge absent from the frozen canonical DAG

admitted_after_validation: exact frozen-cohort transaction-model comparison against M91 and M89 K6
forbidden: RTL correctness, selector timing feasibility or synthesized PPA
equal-area, accuracy, full-network, system, DATE headline or best-paper claim
